b2-lakhatas-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Courtyard and the Caretaker
b2-lakhatas-01.scenario: On a walking tour of Erzsébetváros, a visitor stops in the courtyard of an old Pest tenement and asks you, the guide, how life around the open gallery worked. You describe the courtyard and the caretaker's gate.
b2-lakhatas-01.prompt: Tell the visitor about the courtyard and the caretaker.
cues: Say which courtyard the galleries ran around
Say when the gate was locked
b2-lakhatas-01.target: A belső udvar, amely körül a körfolyosók húzódtak, hangos volt. A kapu, amely mellett a házmester lakott, este tíz órakor bezárult.
b2-lakhatas-01.english: The inner courtyard, around which the galleries ran, was loud. The gate, beside which the caretaker lived, was locked at ten in the evening.
b2-lakhatas-01.canDo: I can describe the architecture and social life of 19th-century Budapest courtyard tenement buildings (gangos bérházak).

b2-lakhatas-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Model Estate in Kispest
b2-lakhatas-02.scenario: A friend visiting Kispest asks you what makes Wekerletelep special. You tell your friend about the estate, its main square and its gardens.
cues: Say what kind of estate it was and what stood on its territory
Say which square is its centre and who designed its buildings
Mention the gardens of the houses
b2-lakhatas-02.target: Wekerletelep állami mintatelep volt, amelynek területén iskola, piac és kertes házak álltak. A Fő tér, amely körül népi szecessziós épületek állnak, Kós Károly és a Fiatalok terve szerint épült.
b2-lakhatas-02.english: Wekerletelep was a state model estate, on the territory of which a school, a market and houses with gardens stood. The Main Square, around which folk Secession buildings stand, was built to the plans of Károly Kós and the Young Ones.
b2-lakhatas-02.canDo: I can explain the origins, architectural philosophy, and community life of Kispest's Wekerletelep.

b2-lakhatas-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Moving into a Panel Flat
b2-lakhatas-03.scenario: In Óbuda, a visitor from abroad asks you why many families were glad to move into the new panel flats in the 1960s. You compare the new flats with the old room-and-kitchen flats.
b2-lakhatas-03.prompt: Tell the visitor why the panel flat was a step forward.
cues: Say what the panel flat offered
Compare it with the old room-and-kitchen flat
Say what the old flat was like
b2-lakhatas-03.target: A panellakás összkomfortos volt. A régi szoba-konyhás lakás, amelyhez képest ez nagy kényelem volt, sötét volt.
b2-lakhatas-03.english: The panel flat had all modern conveniences. The old room-and-kitchen flat, compared to which this was great comfort, was dark.
b2-lakhatas-03.canDo: I can recount the social and urban planning history of Hungarian prefabricated housing estates (lakótelepek).

b2-lakhatas-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Ruin Bars in the Old Jewish Quarter
b2-lakhatas-04.scenario: At a table in a courtyard in Erzsébetváros, a visitor asks you about the ruin bars. You say what they became and what changed in the narrow streets.
b2-lakhatas-04.prompt: Tell the visitor about the ruin bars and their neighbourhood.
cues: Say what the ruin bar became for young artists
Say how the visitors reached the courtyards
Say what changed in the streets
b2-lakhatas-04.target: A romkocsma olyan kulturális központ lett, amely köré sok fiatal alkotó gyűlt össze. A szűk utcák, amelyeken keresztül a látogatók az udvarokba érkeztek, a buliturizmus miatt zajosak lettek.
b2-lakhatas-04.english: The ruin bar became a cultural centre around which many young artists gathered. The narrow streets, through which visitors arrived in the courtyards, became noisy because of party tourism.
b2-lakhatas-04.canDo: I can analyze the rise of ruin bars (romkocsmák) and cultural revival in Budapest's historic 7th District.

b2-lakhatas-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Housing and the City Today
b2-lakhatas-05.scenario: A student at a Budapest university asks you about the housing question in the city. You tell the student what many families did and what urbanists suggest.
b2-lakhatas-05.prompt: Tell the student about the housing question in Budapest.
cues: Say what urbanists say about the old industrial sites
b2-lakhatas-05.target: Sok család az agglomerációba költözött, ahol mindennapos dugók vannak. Az urbanisták szerint a volt rozsdaövezetek, amelyeknek a területén új lakónegyedek épülnek, segíthetnek a lakhatási válságon.
b2-lakhatas-05.english: Many families moved to the agglomeration, where there are daily traffic jams. According to urbanists, the former brownfield zones, on the territory of which new residential districts are being built, can help with the housing crisis.
b2-lakhatas-05.canDo: I can summarize debates on Budapest housing affordability, suburbanization and urban renewal.

b2-lakhatas-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Short History of Housing in Budapest
b2-lakhatas-consolidation.scenario: A visitor to Budapest asks you for a short history of how people lived there. You mention the courtyard tenements, the garden estate in Kispest and the panel flats.
b2-lakhatas-consolidation.prompt: Give the visitor a short history of housing in Budapest.
cues: Say where the caretaker of a tenement lived
Compare the panel flat with the old flat
b2-lakhatas-consolidation.target: A gangos bérházban a házmester a kapu mellett lakott. Wekerletelep olyan kertváros, amelynek területén kertes házak állnak. A panellakás összkomfortos volt, a régi szoba-konyhás lakáshoz képest sokak szemében nagy előrelépés.
b2-lakhatas-consolidation.english: In the tenement with galleries, the caretaker lived beside the gate. Wekerletelep is a garden city on the territory of which houses with gardens stand. The panel flat had all conveniences, and compared to the old room-and-kitchen flat it was a great step forward for many.
b2-lakhatas-consolidation.canDo: I can trace the social history of Hungarian housing from 19th-century gangos tenements and Wekerletelep to socialist panel estates and modern ruin bars.
